name: Haldir Starweaver
portraitDescription: Elegant and refined, with pale skin often having a golden or silver hue. Hair is typically blonde, silver, or black. Eyes are often gold, silver, or blue. Wearing standard city watch tabard and chainmail, carrying a spear or halberd, looking alert and dutiful. The character's appearance strongly complements their class and job, looking rugged and professional. Key features: pointed ears, slender build, graceful posture, shimmering robes.
